mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_invite (workspace_id, email, role, token_hash, status, invited_by_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{email}, #{role}, #{tokenHash}, 'pending', #{invitedById}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, email, role, token_hash, status, invited_by_id, accepted_by_id, expires_at, exchanged_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace_invite WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}

SELECT i.workspace_id AS workspaceId, w.name AS workspaceName, i.email, i.role, i.status, u.display_name AS invitedByLabel, (i.status = 'pending' AND i.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS valid FROM workspace_invite i JOIN workspace w ON w.id = i.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = i.invited_by_id WHERE i.token_hash = #{tokenHash}

SELECT i.workspace_id AS workspaceId, w.name AS workspaceName, i.email, i.role, i.status, u.display_name AS invitedByLabel, (i.status = 'pending' AND i.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS valid FROM workspace_invite i JOIN workspace w ON w.id = i.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = i.invited_by_id WHERE i.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND i.exchanged_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT i.id, i.email, i.role, i.status, i.expires_at AS expiresAt, i.created_at AS createdAt, u.display_name AS invitedByLabel FROM workspace_invite i LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = i.invited_by_id WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND i.status = 'pending' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_invite SET exchanged_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_invite WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND status = 'pending' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() )
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_invite SET status = 'revoked' WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE workspace_invite SET status = 'revoked' WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND email = #{email} AND status = 'pending'
